name: 20 Questions
description: Think of anything and your AI tries to guess it with yes or no questions.
prompt: A 20 questions game where my AI asks me yes or no questions to guess what I'm thinking of, with categories like animals, famous people or food, and a score of AI against me.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: Piensa en cualquier cosa y tu IA intenta adivinarla con preguntas de sí o no.
